experiment.description: A/A check: half of active users enter and no effect is planted. Any single A/A run is significant 5% of the time at alpha=0.05; tests check that rate across re-randomizations (salts).
experiment.hypothesis: No difference between arms: both receive the same experience.

experiment.description: New onboarding flow. Planted effect in the synthetic data: variant_1 is 1.3x as likely to use an AI feature after the first call.
experiment.hypothesis: The new onboarding flow increases the 14-day activation rate without lowering session duration or 60-day revenue.

caveats: The decision rule applies no multiple-testing or peeking correction: about 1 in 20 experiments without a real effect will show a significant lift.
exp_ai_summary_v1 is an A/A check (identical arms): a SHIP decision here is a false positive by construction, expected in about 5% of runs.
